name: Skynet Artisanal Sourdough Design System
description: Design tokens tailored for an artisanal micro-bakery, featuring warm flour-and-earth tones, tactile warmth, and high contrast for high-concurrency food commerce.

primary.description: Deep roasted crust brown for primary text, branding elements, and primary buttons.

accent.description: Golden wheat/caramel hue for calls-to-action, badges, drop timers, and interactive highlights.

background.description: Warm unbleached flour/linen tone creating an organic, tactile canvas.

surface.description: Card and drawer background surfaces for clear separation of inventory and order details.

text.description: Thoughtfully graded earthy text colors ensuring pristine legibility and WCAG AA compliance.

fontFamily.description: Lora for editorial headings and warm character; Inter for high-readability utilitarian data, prices, and menus.

borderRadius.description: Soft rounded corners evoking organic, hand-shaped artisanal loaves.
